title: How They Will Spend Half of It

story.text: John thinks three thousand {POUNDS} would be generous. His wife Fanny fears it would {IMPOVERISH} their boy. Fifteen hundred, then? An {ANNUITY}? “I cannot imagine how they will spend half of it,” says Fanny. In the end, presents of {FISH} and game will do. But Fanny’s {BROTHER} Edward, {SHY} and {GENTLE}, quietly wins Elinor’s {HEART}.
story.caption: “I cannot imagine how they will spend half of it”
